title: PHerc0306B upper public-response strip, with adjacent known-line control
question: Does the fixed upper response have trackable stroke-like arrangement in a separate public Reader V3 map, when sensitivity and coordinate correspondence are judged beside the same-surface known line?
status: proposal; no following experiment executed in R224

input_assets.retrieval: full file once, verify whole SHA256 before use
full file once, verify whole SHA256 before use
full file once, verify whole SHA256 before use

reuse: R224 x/y/z.tif and meta; original claim and TRACE PNGs; exact source coordinate code; R224 public reading metadata
mesh_lookup_convention: Use author carrier/exclusion rule render pixel=grid/scale. Do not transplant R222 renderer half-pixel centre conventions into these published maps. Physical CT correspondence remains unverified.

display.orientation: raw native integer crop, then flipud once for reading; do not claim pixel identity with remapped public PNG
display.raw: probabilities 0..1 mapped linearly to 0..255; preserve NaN as visibly invalid, finite zero is data not a mask
display.auxiliary: one median to p99.9 per model over the union of the two frozen bands, limited to finite model values AND four-corner valid geometry AND CT>0; use the same resulting limits for known and upper bands; no per-tile stretch or depth sweep
display.mask_caveat: CT>0 and finite mesh are display-support proxies, not physical-paper or absence-of-ink labels
display.reference: source claim PNG only a frozen location/appearance reference; do not reconstruct annotations as strokes
display.native_views: 4416-wide overview may be reduced for location, plus complete native strips in overlapping horizontal tiles <=1152 px; keep a shared 128 px halo for continuity

known_reference: author letter_dimensions.json line1 shapes, including adjacent upright/cross strokes and right enclosed dark cavity; fixed reported line2 pi is auxiliary only

decision.retain: the separate Reader V3 map supplies additional spatially coherent stroke/arrangement evidence for the preselected upper group or an adjacent continuation in the frozen upper band, calibrated against its known-line control; record concrete matching and conflicting shapes. Do not require pixelwise agreement, and do not retain solely because the already-seen TRACE pattern reappears.
decision.known_control_failure: if Reader V3 cannot show the already known coarse shapes and placements, its upper silence is not a negative control; report comparator failure with no new CT investment justified by this comparison, and do not rescue by threshold/depth/model changes
decision.no_candidate: if both separate native maps leave only broad isolated or untraceable responses after known control is established, close this fixed published-map test without inferring absent ink
decision.after_retention: next research may obtain local original CT / independent surface geometry for that exact candidate and audit prior reading; new-letter or prize claim requires additional evidence
decision.stop: input SHA/shape or coordinate failure; insufficient memory/free C; global network deadline; no silent fallback to zeros, no parameter sweep or second target

limitations: Target is already visible in public context and not established as previously unseen or unread.
TRACE and claim product share TRACE and A-hn teacher lineage; their similarity is not independent corroboration.
Reader V3 has a separate model family here, but common CT/errors can be correlated and disagreement is weak evidence.
Author claims 0306B not in public-model training; initialization/full training-coordinate audit not done here.
Mesh numeric continuity and displayed CT do not prove the upper site and known line belong to one physical lamina.
PHerc0306B already received its First Letters prize. This experiment targets added reading/candidates, not a new eligible-scroll award.
